description: Public edition: Models possible transitions to highly automated economies, advanced space industries, and new forms of social organization.
body:
Civilization Transition Laboratory. Models possible transitions to highly automated economies, advanced space industries, and new forms of social organization.

This database covers the technology as item 216 entry 60 of Manon's "100 Technologies Beyond Omega (B)" catalog, section "Civilization Engineering Beyond One Planet". It is the public edition: every factual claim below is drawn from real public science and engineering, honestly labeled.

Feasibility tier: theoretically plausible. Transition modeling is scenario work; validated transition science is unproven.

Classification: public database. This record profiles the technology; companion records cover known science, constraints, approaches, tools, unresolved problems, evidence, and outlook.

Known science foundations of Civilization Transition Laboratory.

Economists model automation transitions. Space-industry roadmaps exist. But modeling civilizational transitions — validated — is speculative; history is the only dataset.
